ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 60-70% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central regions of both lobes, contrasted against low-intensity black pixels at the trailing edges and central peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central interior of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the entire trailing edge boundary. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips; the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, localized clusters of yellowish-brown circular pixel groupings (barnacles) are situated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Sparse dark focal spots are visible within the white interior regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible across the white ventral surface, primarily oriented in a vertical and diagonal manner towards the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive localized barnacle colonization at the distal extremities of both lobes; irregular notches and potential tissue loss along the serrated trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast yellow/brown texture on the fluke tips due to dense barnacle clusters, distinct from the primary black and white pigmentation mapping.
